best_for: White-dial watch with a gold-tone strap
verdict: A 30 mm white-dial watch with a gold-tone brass strap, in the Fria range.
paragraphs: The Timex India listing gives a 30 mm brass case, a round white dial with three hands, and a brass strap in gold tone. The glass is mineral glass and the movement is quartz.
The listing gives 30 m water resistance and a one-year warranty against manufacturer defects. It also lists scratch resistance and shock resistance as "No".
The listing describes it as "an elegant and versatile timepiece" with a "pristine white round dial".
good: In our view, a plain white dial is easy to match with clothes
Mineral glass cover, per the listing
1 year warranty against manufacturer defects, per Timex India
not_good: The listing says no scratch resistance or shock resistance
The listing gives only "30m" for water resistance
